title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: each candidate trained past the edges of its tuning grid, stage 2 of 2
description: Continues the six 150,000-update learners of exp-lcf-cost-budget-340 to 300,000 updates (net2_resume: every weight, optimizer moment and random state carried over, so each run ends as one 300,000-update run would): TD3+BC behind seven free latents at alpha 2.5 and 10, and the larger decision maker on the true LCFs at alpha 1 and 2.5 and on neto1 v1's estimates at alpha 10 and 30, training seeds 0 and 1, every other setting unchanged. A hosted job's 6-hour limit stops one job near 150,000 updates (stage 1 took 2.2 to 4.0 hours). Stage 1 reproduced the earlier 150,000-update runs exactly (the same final critic loss), so these extend the policies already scored. Each learner is saved again for a third stage if 300,000 still improves. A search on links 0 to 99 then picks each candidate's configuration among the old and new budgets. summary.md lists each policy's training diagnostics.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; A="$IN/a/$CFG-n150k-s$SEED"; [ -f "$A/learner.pt" ] && [ -f "$A/train.json" ]; O="$OUT/$CFG-n300k-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$O"; jq --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg r "$A/learner.pt" '.data = [$d] | .net1_from = $n | .net2_resume = $r | .save_learner = true | .net2.steps = 300000' "$A/train.json" > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| policy | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcft*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
